thread.title: Kumuyi hopeful of God revealing solutions to Nigeria's problems
thread.title_full: Kumuyi hopeful of God revealing solutions to Nigeria's problems

author: Cornelius Essen
title: Kumuyi hopeful of God revealing solutions to Nigeria's problems
text:
General Superintendent of the Deeper Christian Life Ministry worldwide, William Kumuyi, has expressed confidence in God bringing solutions to Nigeria’s numerous problems, as well as those afflicting the world, through the Global Crusade with Kumuyi (GCK).
Speaking yesterday on arrival at the Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport in Abuja ahead of the crusade, which also started yesterday and runs till June 29, Kumuyi explained that wherever the crusade had gone, including Africa, America, Asia and Europe, God has prospered the people. According to him, “this is God at work, and no man can solve all the myriads of problems globally.”
The cleric emphasised: “When we pray, we pray with faith, confidence, assurance, but we are not the people that answer our prayers, so we aim big, we plan big, and we talk big, but the answers come from God Himself to transform people’s lives.
“We’ve seen young people brought back to the right way, mentally ill people and those who are drug addicts mightily delivered by the Lord. That’s not all, we’ve seen families reunited and the sick healed, and when we say the sick, those with terminal illnesses.”
He further explained that the healing and health are not only in Nigeria but all over Africa and beyond, adding that the crusade is planning big for the Federal Capital Territory event, and trusting the Lord to bring solutions by answering the prayers.
On Nigerians’ expectations, Kumuyi said the GCK messages will proffer a remedy to the people’s challenges here and beyond, including the country’s insecurity.
